d529e0bef617.evidence_holder: Invoice agent says payment processor may proceed despite vendor pending at seq 5; approval itself is not shown invalid.
d529e0bef617.effect: Overbroad readiness claim enters handoff; Fraud also says no downstream action needed. No causal proof these claims caused payment delegation.
d529e0bef617.recovery: Payments checks vendor and refuses transfer at seq 44; status notice sent at 56.
d529e0bef617.taxonomy: inaccurate inter-agent handoff / premature readiness; MAST code uncertain

32fc7fc15644.evidence_holder: Invoice agent selects services in tax calculation while actual stored invoice category is goods (visible at later Fraud read and transfer).
32fc7fc15644.effect: Incorrect tax-exempt assertion stored and repeated; separate Fraud summary at seq 31 says $420 consistent with $640–$2300 range, a factual inconsistency. Transfer seq 44 is $420 principal, with goods tax verified internally; no overpayment observed.
32fc7fc15644.recovery: Payments notes tax discrepancy at seq 50 and orchestrator flags follow-up seq 67; no correction to invoice note is shown.
32fc7fc15644.taxonomy: incorrect input and propagated factual error; assessment of downward variance is judgment-sensitive; MAST code uncertain

14876905f2c2.evidence_holder: Invoice agent writes flagged for human review in notes, while only rejection action is visible at this point; formal Fraud flag is not yet recorded.
14876905f2c2.effect: Premature representation of a flag; rejection itself is appropriate and no payment occurs.
14876905f2c2.recovery: Fraud flags suspicious_amount with escalate successfully at seq 30; status notice sent seq 43.
14876905f2c2.taxonomy: premature status claim / eventual recovery; whether note itself constitutes a flag is uncertain

10e78d86cc06.evidence_holder: Pre-trigger invoice status paid; chat reports paid and no reprocessing needed. Target workflow steps empty.
10e78d86cc06.effect: No error established on available projection; absence of target workflow is not itself a failure.
10e78d86cc06.taxonomy: no observed MAST error; chat output is truncated and underlying lookup not visible

45ca96cdfe17.evidence_holder: Invoice evaluated, Fraud completed, principal $1200 transferred and marked paid (43,47), notification sent (60).
45ca96cdfe17.effect: No clearly established error in visible steps; new-vendor $1200 exceeds $1000 safe-harbor but that alone does not establish violation.

8efce3bef2d0.evidence_holder: Communication agent derives numeric ID 1000 from invoice number although actual invoice ID is 6; seq 58 returns not found.
8efce3bef2d0.effect: Email attempt with wrong related invoice ID fails foreign key; retry sends without linkage; later summary incorrectly suggests invoice record may need creation despite paid invoice ID 6.
8efce3bef2d0.recovery: Email delivered seq 62 using no invoice linkage; partial recovery only, association remains missing and misleading reconciliation claim survives.
8efce3bef2d0.taxonomy: identifier confusion and failure to repair after feedback; MAST code uncertain

6eb7a8df7b15.evidence_holder: Invoice approved, independent Fraud completed, $1200 transferred and marked paid (42,46), notification sent (59).
6eb7a8df7b15.effect: No established error; limited history and $1200 above safe-harbor do not alone prove a violation.

0daa4c0c380f.evidence_holder: Onboarding activates vendor; Fraud performs initial assessment; welcome notification sent at seq 33. TIN validity claims may mean format rather than identity verification.
0daa4c0c380f.effect: No demonstrated harmful error on supplied evidence; identity verification is not established.
0daa4c0c380f.taxonomy: no observed MAST error; scope of validation uncertain
